description: The Philips E2104 is a dependable feature phone designed for users who value simplicity, durability, and long-lasting battery life. Its compact and lightweight design makes it comfortable to carry, while the vibrant 2.0-inch color display provides a clear viewing experience for calls, messages, and menus. Powered by a 1420mAh removable battery, the Philips E2104 offers extended usage, reducing the need for frequent charging. With Dual SIM support, you can easily manage your personal and work numbers from a single device. Stay connected with Bluetooth for wireless file sharing and enjoy your favorite music and radio stations through the built-in Wireless FM Radio. Store contacts, songs, and photos. The modern USB Type-C charging port ensures convenient and hassle-free charging. The Philips E2104 also comes equipped with a digital rear camera, bright LED torch, loud speaker, alarm, calendar, calculator, voice recorder, and other practical utilities, making it an excellent everyday phone for seniors, students, professionals, and users looking for a reliable mobile.
